title: 第十四章 《白夜》首播，谩骂与夸赞（求追读）
slug: 华娱从继承视频网站开始
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

【《白夜追凶》定档3月15日！潘岳明，李一彤领衔主演！】

“？？？？？？”

“我眼睛没花吧？定档了？真要播了？”

“不行，我受不了了，我看到潘岳明领衔主演这几个字我就想吐。”

“这个p站绝对是疯了，骂了这么久，居然就这么铁了心要用他拍戏。”

“这个世界疯了，董婕和孩子被渣男伤害得还没走出来，而姓潘的却已经开始捞钱，真的讽刺。”

“举报，我要去举报！必须下架这部剧！”

“坚决抵制劣迹艺人的剧！”

“没事的，蹭热度又能蹭多少？papi酱第一期播放量破千万，后面几期都是二三百万，这种卑劣的招术用不了多久。”

“二三百万少吗？《大鹏嘚吧嘚》一期也就一二百，《白夜追凶》随便捞点都够恶心死人。”

“不一样，这突然冒出来的papi酱一看就有东西，节目靠她一个人撑起来。可是你以为苏行舟这种人能拍出什么好剧吗？肯定扑街。”

“不管怎么说，坚决抵制就是了！”

“.......”

#潘岳明新剧定档#

#p站潘岳明#

果然不出苏行舟所料，有了前一段时间的铺垫，真正定档的时候果然掀起了轩然大波。

这次的骂声，要比以往都要狠。

苏行舟这不是火上浇油了，完全是坟头蹦迪了。

特别是这段时间，董婕的舆论越来越上风。

《papi酱的胡说八道》首期爆火的时候，还有不知道哪来的小道消息说董婕看了难以接受。

董婕的几个好朋友都站出来纷纷谴责苏行舟的行为是在吃人血馒头。

为她站台的人中最出名的人叫陈昆。

两人在《金粉世家》结识，关系非常好。

也是这次风波中，唯一一个敢站出来公开力挺董婕的明星。

有趣的是，陈昆没敢点名道姓说潘岳明什么，却在前一周发微博怒斥p站吃人血馒头，毫无底线。

正是因为“受害者董婕”的反应，让大家更加心疼，对p站百般厌恶，恨不得这破网站当场倒闭。

就是这样的舆论巅峰，p站还敢顶风作案，官宣定档。

任谁看了都要称赞一声，吃了豹子胆。

就是在这样的情况中，《白夜追凶》开播了。

一口气放出五集！

content_en:
Page (1/3)

["White Night" is scheduled to be released on March 15th!Starring Pan Yueming and Li Yitong!】

"???????"

"My eyes are not blurred, are they? Is it scheduled to be broadcast? Is it really going to be broadcast?"

"No, I can't stand it anymore. When I saw the words Pan Yueming starring, I wanted to vomit."

"This p station is absolutely crazy. After scolding him for so long, he is so determined to use him in filming."

"The world is crazy. Dong Jie and her children were hurt by a scumbag and they haven't come out yet, but Pan has already started making money. It's really ironic."

"Report it, I'm going to report it! This show must be removed!"

"Resolutely boycott dramas written by bad actors!"

"It's okay, how much more popularity can you keep? Papi-chan's first episode has over 10 million views, and the following episodes have 2-3 million views. This despicable trick won't last long."

"Is two to three million too little? One issue of "Dapeng's Bar" is only one or two hundred, and "White Night Chasing" is enough to make people sick."

"It's different. This Papi Jiang who suddenly appeared has something right at first sight. She alone supports the show. But do you think someone like Su Xingzhou can make any good dramas? It will definitely be a hit."

"No matter what, just resist firmly!"

"...."

# Pan Yueming’s new drama is scheduled to be released#

#p站 Pan Yueming#

As expected by Su Xingzhou, with the foreshadowing made some time ago, there was indeed an uproar when the schedule was actually set.

This time the scolding was harsher than before.

Su Xingzhou didn't just add fuel to the fire, he was completely upset.

Especially during this period, Dong Jie's public opinion became more and more popular.

When the first issue of "Papi Jiang's Nonsense" became a hit, there were rumors that Dong Jie found it difficult to accept.

Several of Dong Jie's good friends stood up and condemned Su Xingzhou's behavior as eating steamed buns with human blood.

The most famous person who stood up for her was Chen Kun.

The two met in "Golden Pink Family" and have a very good relationship.

She is also the only celebrity who dared to stand up and publicly support Dong Jie during this controversy.

What’s interesting is that Chen Kun didn’t dare to mention Pan Yueming by name, but he posted on Weibo the previous week angrily criticizing Station P for eating human blood steamed buns, which has no bottom line.

It is precisely because of the reaction of the "victim Dong Jie" that everyone feels even more distressed and hates Station P in every possible way, wishing that this bad website would close down on the spot.

At such a peak of public opinion, Station P still dared to commit crimes and officially announced it.

Anyone who sees it will praise it and take the courage of a leopard.

It was under such circumstances that "White Night" was launched.

Release five episodes in one go!
